name: Saint-Estèphe

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
A ranking for Médoc châteaux left out of the 1855 classification. Any Médoc property may apply.

In 1855 brokers ranked Bordeaux estates by reputation and price. Reds were ranked from first to fifth growths, nearly all in the Médoc, and the sweet whites of Sauternes and Barsac from superior first growth to second growth.

notes: It is known as slow to mature and among the toughest, most tannic Bordeaux.

blurb.text: A Left Bank Bordeaux appellation in the Médoc for red wine. The 1855 classification ranks five of its estates as classified growths.
